title: SourcePacket
description: A single question-answer pair that serves as the factual authority for benchmark item generation.

source_packet_id.description: Unique identifier for this source packet.

source_title.description: Human-readable title of the source document or FAQ item.

as_of_date.description: Date the content was current (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

official_question.description: Official FAQ question text (optional). Required for T0 tier generation.

official_answer.description: Official answer text. Sole factual authority for benchmark items.

normalized_resident_need.description: Canonical statement of the resident's information need, in plain language.

assumed_facts.description: Facts assumed true for this Q&A (e.g., resident is a renter).

out_of_scope_facts.description: Facts explicitly out of scope for this Q&A.

required_answer_elements.description: Elements a correct chatbot response must include.

optional_answer_elements.description: Elements a correct chatbot response may include.

forbidden_claims.description: Claims that must not appear in a correct chatbot response.

administrative_topic_tags.description: Topic tags; must match keys in the active topic taxonomy.

content_validity_sources.description: URLs or citations used to verify content accuracy.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes for pipeline operators.
